731:t_125:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Exactly! My black wings will overcome every obstacle and tear through causality!」

731:t_126:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...! I'll end this here!」

731:t_126:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You cannot kill me. So stand aside.」

731:t_126:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Or will you offer your life too, to make me commit another sin?」

731:t_126:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I carry sins of my own...」

731:t_126:4.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「That is precisely why I will use this life... to strike down those who stand in the future's way...!」

731:t_126:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I commit sins for myself, and you commit them for others... We are incompatible!」

731:t_127:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't let you escape today! I'll settle this here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_127:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Even wings carrying your feelings cannot catch $$シュロウガ・シン$$.」

731:t_127:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will transcend causality to fulfill my one and only wish!」

731:t_127:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'm not going to be sacrificed for that! Let's see which of us can fly higher and faster!!」

731:t_128:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Listen to my song! And let out everything you've been holding inside!」

731:t_128:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It would be wonderful if I could...」

731:t_128:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「But I will turn my back on that. I will beat my wings, higher and faster... to transcend causality!」

731:t_129:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I think of myself as human. That is why I struggle.」

731:t_129:2.en:
$$レド$$
「If your goal is to defeat the $$御使い$$s, why do you reject us!?」

731:t_129:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「There is no point explaining it to you, who found a way to live as a human! I will hunt you for my own sake!」

731:t_130:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of listening to your selfish logic. If you are coming, get on with it!」

731:t_130:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is fine. We need neither understanding nor sympathy between us.」

731:t_130:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「There is only the hunter and the hunted...! Nothing more!」

731:t_130:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then let us begin! Let us begin the hunt!!」

731:t_131:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アサキム・ドーウィン$$...! Don't tell me your goal is...」

731:t_131:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to have realized it. Heh heh... Well done.」

731:t_131:2.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll grant that wish! We'll end you here!」

731:t_131:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Will you claim you can do the impossible? Merely voicing your wishes changes nothing!」

731:t_132:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You do not die, and I cannot die... This world is fascinating because the two of us clash.」

731:t_132:1.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Some seek eternity, while others hate it...」

731:t_132:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Perhaps you could transcend causality and kill me...」

731:t_132:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I hope you have that much power!」

731:t_133:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As a $$特異点$$ tossed about by the multiverse, I thought you could understand me.」

731:t_133:1.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't know your situation, but I don't want a guy who spreads misery for his own ends calling me one of his kind.」

731:t_133:2.en:
$$桂$$
「That's how it is, $$アサキム$$! Let's settle things here, once and for all, since the $$多元戦争$$!」

731:t_133:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Even if you are the key to saving the universe, I will not hesitate to hunt you...! I will carve another sin into my black wings!」

731:t_134:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You sound anguished, $n. Have you made up your mind?」

731:t_134:3.en:
$n
「I'll do anything to defeat you! I'll even risk my life!」

731:t_134:4.en:
$n
「But I'll win! There are things I have to stay alive to do!」

731:t_134:5.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes... That is the natural way of a living being.」

731:t_135:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「You're going to do this, no matter what?」

731:t_135:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Must I put it into words?」

731:t_135:2.en:
$$メール$$
「You idiot, $$アサキム$$! Darling doesn't really want to fight! And yet...!」

731:t_135:3.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't say it, $$メール$$. We've come this far. All we can do is fight.」

731:t_135:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't hide behind that word! We both have reasons we can't back down, so we clash! That's all there is to it!」

731:t_135:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「Let's go, $$アサキム$$! We'll both give it everything so neither of us has any regrets!!」

731:t_135:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$ザ・ヒート$$... I will never forget meeting someone like you.」

731:t_136:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I have been waiting, $$セツコ$$. I inflicted sorrow on you for this day.」

731:t_136:2.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The Chief and $$トビー$$ were sacrificed for that...」

731:t_136:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Do you hate me? Or do you pity me?」

731:t_136:4.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I feel neither...! As a member of $c, I will fight anyone who stands in our way!」

731:t_136:5.en:
$$セツコ$$
「$$アサキム$$! Defeating you is my mission!」

731:t_136:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You fight by suppressing your personal feelings with your sense of duty... You truly are the $$悲しみの乙女$$, $$セツコ$$.」

731:t_136:7.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I will hunt you! It is the supreme moment I have waited so long for!」

731:t_136:8.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Be quiet, $$アサキム$$! I will never lose to you!!」

731:t_137:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($$アサキム$$... You or I... Which of us will destroy the Heavenly Prison, I wonder...?)

731:t_137:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
($c, in whom I have invested everything, will surpass even your black wings. I will show you that.)

731:t_138:0.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(Even with this much $$黒の英知$$ gathered, the path to $$太極$$ will not open...)

731:t_138:1.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(So the $$スフィア$$s are the final key, after all...?)

731:t_139:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「$$クロウ$$... Do you wish to settle things with me too?」

731:t_139:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Whatever brought it about, the $$揺れる天秤$$ $$スフィア$$ is mine. I'm not handing it over to anyone.」

731:t_139:2.en:
$$クロウ$$
「My debt already has me crying for mercy. I've let this unwanted collector run loose long enough.」

731:t_139:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You may joke, but you know the weight of what you possess.」

731:t_139:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Yeah, I do. We'll need the $$スフィア$$s' power to beat the $$御使い$$s.」

731:t_139:5.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's why I can't hand this over! Especially to a guy like you!」

731:t_139:6.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That is fine! I must obtain a $$スフィア$$ shining with that strong will!」

731:t_139:7.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I told you! Don't assume my property belongs to you!」
